title: Post-Mockup UI Closure - Mission Control First Viewport, Readability, and Final Parity
goal: Close the remaining visual and operator-readability gap between the live AegisPT UI and the root mockups after the completed backlog-110, backlog-111, and backlog-112 slices, using a hard mockup design-language parity gate rather than subjective polish.
scope: Use codex/results/system-review-and-ui-plan-20260425.md, codex/results/mockup-design-language-parity-gate-20260425.md, wizard_mockup.html, ui_mockup.html, and UI_REDESIGN_SPEC.md as the planning inputs. This is a focused UI closure slice only: first extract the root mockup design tokens and component inventory, then make Mission Control show the operational 3-column run view above the fold, make selected-task stdout/latest-output unmistakably readable, repair AI Signal degraded/error states, tighten Findings empty/drawer/filter behavior, and strengthen Surface Map's map-canvas truth. Preserve existing backend contracts and deterministic runtime behavior.
generation_reason: A planning-only system review on 2026-04-25 found that the completed mockup-alignment work moved the UI in the right direction but still only scores 6.7/10 against wizard_mockup.html and ui_mockup.html. The user approved moving this UI closure directly after the installation package and asked for a stricter way to make the design language match the mockups exactly. The largest live gaps are Mission Control first-viewport priority, readable live task output, AI Signal contrast/error treatment, Findings empty/drawer behavior, Surface Map visual truth, and inconsistent old-vs-new component language.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: UI closure only. Do not add new product features, new backend endpoints, new schemas, new runner behavior, or runtime self-modification. Keep changes additive and preserve existing test IDs on data-bearing components.
constraints.visual_parity_not_optional: The task may not close on green tests alone. It must include before/after screenshots, a token/component parity checklist, and a final visual-language score.
constraints.mockup_data_boundary: Dynamic product data may differ from the static mockups, but shell geometry, component language, spacing, color/radius treatment, and first-viewport hierarchy must match the mockups unless a documented safety/product-truth exception is recorded.

success_criteria: A token parity checklist records the live values for topbar height, sidebar width, content padding, background/surface/border/text/accent colors, radii, shadows, and core type sizes against wizard_mockup.html and ui_mockup.html.

A component parity checklist covers topbar, sidebar, page headers, cards, chips, badges, buttons, filters, right drawers, report cards, task rows, terminal/output blocks, empty states, and map/canvas panels.
The post-implementation visual-language score is at least 9.0/10 overall, or any lower score is explicitly accepted by the user before closure.
No touched first-viewport keeps old large explanatory panels, old decorative strips, raw backend exception text, or compatibility-route chrome as primary visual language.
Mission Control first viewport at 1440x900 shows scan map, task list, selected-task output/latest command output, and AI/context without the setup checklist dominating the screen.
Selected or running task output is readable on the main Mission Control screen without requiring Explorer, Evidence Replay, or another route.
AI Signal provider-error, disabled, empty, and review-needed states use high-contrast compact operator copy and hide raw backend URLs or exception text behind disclosure.
Findings filters are collapsed by default and zero-finding runs do not force a large empty right drawer.
Findings with real findings keep the list-plus-drawer pattern from ui_mockup.html with readable row density, severity dots, badges, and detail actions.
Surface Map either renders a useful readable map visualization from real data or falls back to a compact truthful inventory summary; it must not show a clipped decorative strip.
Reports remains at least as strong as the current mockup-aligned card-grid/run-strip baseline.
The live UI score in the follow-up review reaches at least 8.0/10 against wizard_mockup.html and ui_mockup.html.
No backend, worker, migration, finding schema, pack lifecycle, approval flow, deployment flow, or runtime binding changes.
must_not_touch: pack validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

visual_checks: Capture fresh desktop screenshots for intake, Mission Control, Findings, Reports, and Surface Map.
Capture fresh mobile/narrow screenshots for the touched screens.
Compare against wizard_mockup.html and ui_mockup.html and record a UI score in codex/results/.
Capture root mockup screenshots at 1440x900 before implementation.
Capture live before/after screenshots at 1440x900, 1280x800, and 390x844 for touched screens.
Record a token/component parity checklist in codex/results/.
Record the final per-screen and overall UI score in codex/results/.
acceptance_criteria: Mission Control no longer opens with setup checklist as the dominant first-viewport element when setup is mostly complete.
Task output/latest command output is visible and readable in Mission Control.
AI Signal error states are readable and compact.
Findings empty state and drawer behavior are calm and mockup-consistent.
Surface Map visual region is useful or explicitly summarized, not decorative/clipped.
Final visual-language score is at least 9.0/10 unless explicitly accepted lower by the user.
Design-language parity is judged from screenshots and token/component checklist, not only from passing functional tests.
All documented deviations from the root mockups are product-truth or safety-truth exceptions, not unfinished polish.

before_promotion: Installation Package (backlog-81) is either complete or the user explicitly reprioritizes UI closure ahead of it.
The visual review artifact codex/results/system-review-and-ui-plan-20260425.md remains available.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with the UI closure implementation and final UI score.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the new UI baseline and any residual UI risks.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if promotion is not appropriate.

authority: wizard_mockup.html controls intake, step treatment, tile language, chips, card tone, and general product calmness.
ui_mockup.html controls the app-wide shell, topbar/sidebar, Mission Control, Findings, Reports, and screen layouts.
UI_REDESIGN_SPEC.md supports the implementation, but the root mockups win for this closure slice when they conflict with older UI language.
design_language_gate.parity_target: Design-language parity, not static sample-data parity.
design_language_gate.minimum_score: 9.0/10 overall unless the user explicitly accepts a lower score.
